parameters.bodyParametersJson:
={
  "to": {{ JSON.stringify($json.learner_emails) }},
  "subject": "{{ $json.product }} Best Practices Updated",
  "body": "Hi there,

The {{ $json.product }} best practices baseline has been updated with the latest information, including:
- Recent documentation updates
- Approved procedure changes
- Insights from recent Q&A
- Knowledge from team transitions

Your learning modules have been automatically updated. View the new baseline: {{ $json.baseline_url }}

TIPS Knowledge Team"
}

parameters.query:
=CREATE (b:Baseline {id: '{{ $json.baseline_id }}', product: '{{ $json.product }}', created: '{{ $json.created_date }}'})
WITH b
MATCH (d:Document) WHERE d.product = '{{ $json.product }}' AND d.currency_status = 'current'
CREATE (b)-[r:SYNTHESIZES]->(d)
RETURN b, r
